sourceTitle: Payments and Finances for Fostering with Coventry City Council 2026/2027
feesNote: Coventry pays mainstream foster carers a weekly fee for each child on top of the allowance, at a standard or enhanced level.
extras: Five extra weeks of fostering allowance a year, paid at key times for birthdays, festivals, holidays and clothing
Mileage at 45p a mile for some additional journeys
£5 a week of the allowance is saved for the child and passed to them at 18
summary: Coventry's 2026/2027 scheme pays a weekly fostering allowance by the child's age, plus a standard or enhanced weekly fee per child for mainstream carers. Carers also receive five extra weeks of allowance across the year for birthdays, festivals, holidays and clothing.
